---
name: Skill proposal
about: Propose a new skill, or a material change to an existing one
title: ''
labels: skill
assignees: ''
---

**problem**
What goes wrong today without this skill. Be concrete; a recurring failure
beats a general improvement.

**trigger**
When should an agent load this? Write it the way the description will read.
If it overlaps an existing skill, say which one and why a separate skill is
better than editing that one.

**shape**
Roughly what the skill instructs. A few bullets is enough.

**cost**
Always loaded or on demand? Rough size? Anything it pulls in with it.

**provenance**
New, or adapted from somewhere? If adapted, link the upstream and its license.

**how we would know it works**
The observable difference between a session with it and one without.
